overview: Gaurav.Create is an ultra-premium futuristic creator platform with cyberpunk aesthetics, project marketplace, real-time community chat, membership tiers, and an owner-only dashboard.
features: Cinematic cyberpunk homepage with animated hero, live stats, and featured projects
Internet Identity authentication with premium sign-in experience and user profiles
Project marketplace with search, filters, category browsing, and detail pages
Real-time community chat with Free/Premium/VIP rooms, emoji reactions, and typing indicators
Owner-only dashboard for project management, chat moderation, and announcements
Automated chat moderation with spam detection, profanity filtering, and anti-scam protection
Membership tier system (FREE/PREMIUM/VIP) with animated badges
Social media integration for YouTube, Instagram, and Discord
Floating dock navigation, custom glow cursor, and premium micro-animations
